Inclusive Gateway

General Concept: An Inclusive Gateway in BPMN is used to model decision points where one or more outgoing paths can be taken based on conditions. It allows for parallel and conditional branching.

 

TaktX Implementation: In TaktX, Inclusive Gateways use FEEL expressions to evaluate conditions on outgoing sequence flows. The engine can select multiple paths if their conditions are met. Variable scoping and input mappings can be used to provide data for condition evaluation.

Usage & Options in TaktX:
An Inclusive Gateway in TaktX allows you to:

  • Control process flow by evaluating conditions and selecting one or more outgoing paths.
  • Define conditions using FEEL expressions for each outgoing sequence flow.
  • Use input mappings to provide data for condition evaluation.
  • Configure error handling for overlapping or missing conditions.
  • Monitor gateway decisions and audit results via the TaktX client.
  • Use for flexible decision points and branching logic in workflows.

 

Example: Insurance Claim Routing with Inclusive Gateway

 

This example shows a process where an Inclusive Gateway routes an insurance claim to one or more departments (Medical, Property, Legal) based on conditions. This demonstrates flexible, multi-path routing in TaktX.

Tips & Tricks:

  • Use clear conditions for each outgoing flow.
  • Document the logic for each path.
  • Test gateway behavior with different input data.

Pitfalls:

  • Overlapping or missing conditions can cause process errors.
  • Unmapped variables may lead to incorrect path selection.
